script: This is another reason NBA players are on a different level. The Professor was teaching Jason Williams one of his signature moves, and probably didn't expect him to do it immediately. He broke it down step by step: use a behind-the-back dribble to open the defender's legs, hit an in-and-out crossover, then finish with a behind-the-back nutmeg for an easy layup. But Jason Williams was known for having one of the flashiest styles in the NBA, so a move like this was nothing new to him. And when he finally tried it, he copied it perfectly on the first attempt, then even added his own trick shot finish.
what_makes_it_work: High contrast between a streetball legend teaching and an NBA veteran successfully executing the move
Seamless transition between instructional footage and historical NBA clips
Fast-paced editing matching the energetic voiceover and beat
